format.melody: Bars separated by |. A note is letter + optional # or b (## / bb) + octave + duration (w h q e s = whole, half, quarter, eighth, sixteenth), then optional . (dotted) and ~ (tied to the next note of the same pitch). r + duration is a rest. Middle C is C4. Accidentals are the sounding pitch, not relative to the key signature. If the tune has a pickup, the first bar holds only the pickup beats.
format.chords: One entry per full bar (no chord for the pickup), separated by |. Several chords in a bar split it evenly, or give beats with Chord:beats. Qualities: (major) m 7 m7 maj7 dim dim7 m7b5 6 m6 aug sus4 9.
format.band: Default play-along style: swing, twobeat, rock, bossa, ballad (4/4); waltz, jazzwaltz, ballad (3/4).
